calendarNotes: CCSD’s 2026–27 All Schools calendar starts August 17, 2026, with a school phase-in listed online for August 17–19, and ends May 28, 2027. The PDF lists Fall Break October 12–16, Thanksgiving Closure November 26–27, Winter Break December 21–January 1, K–12 non-contact on January 4, second semester beginning January 5, Spring Break March 15–19, K–8 non-contact or conference dates in November, March, and May, and separate school or program calendars for specialized schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cherry Creek School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The All Schools PDF marks Monday, August 17, 2026, as the start of school. CCSD’s online calendar lists a school phase-in from August 17–19, so families should confirm their first-day schedule with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Cherry Creek Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a K–12 non-contact day, and classes resume Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the difference between K–12 and K–8 non-contact days?
calendarFaqs.a: K–12 non-contact days apply to students in grades K–12. K–8 non-contact or conference dates apply to elementary and middle school students, while high schools may follow a different schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CCSD publish separate high school and program calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CCSD publishes separate school and program calendars for high schools, preschool and pre-kindergarten, adaptive programs, Challenge School, innovation campuses, pathways, and alternative programs.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official CCSD calendar page and your student’s school or program calendar before making travel, child care, transportation, testing, or campus-specific plans.
